verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a search engine, since comparable products can be self-hosted, so the axis applies. The evidence describes Algolia only as a hosted service: it provides 'hosted APIs', stores a copy of your data on its own infrastructure, and a community user cites its closed-source license. No evidence shows a self-hostable deployment of the core engine.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
